M.name: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Veggies
M.ing:
1.5 lb chicken thighs
2 cups broccoli florets
1 bell pepper, sliced
1 red onion, wedged
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt & pepper
M.steps:
Heat oven to 425°F / 220°C
Toss everything with oil, lemon juice and spices
Spread on one pan, skin/side up
Roast 25-30 min until chicken hits 165°F

M.name: Air-Fryer Salmon Rice Bowls
M.ing:
2 salmon fillets
2 cups cooked rice
1 cucumber
1 avocado
2 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
1 tbsp honey
Sesame seeds
Sriracha mayo (optional)
M.steps:
Brush salmon with soy + honey
Air fry 400°F for 8-10 min
Flake over rice
Top with cucumber, avocado, sesame & sauce

M.name: One-Pot Turkey Chili

1 lb lean ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cans beans, drained
1 can crushed tomatoes
1 cup corn
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika

Brown turkey with onion
Add spices, stir 1 min
Add tomatoes, beans, corn
Simmer 25 min; portion leftovers

M.name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Burrito Bowls

1 jar salsa
1 can black beans
1 cup corn
1 tbsp taco seasoning

Cook low 6 h or high 3 h
Shred chicken
Serve over rice with toppings

Toss everything in a bowl

G.name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at your chest, elbows tucked.
Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly.
Sit your hips down and back between your heels, chest tall.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back, then drive up through your whole foot.
G.cue: Push your knees out in line with your toes.
G.avoid: Heels lifting or knees caving inward.

G.name: Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Brace your core like you're about to be poked in the stomach.
Bend hips and knees together, sitting down between your heels.
Reach at least parallel, then stand up by pushing the floor away.
G.cue: Keep your chest proud and weight mid-foot.
G.avoid: Rounding your lower back at the bottom.

G.name: Jump Squat
steps: Drop into a quarter-to-half squat, arms back.
Explode up, swinging arms forward, and leave the floor.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, then heels.
Sink straight into the next rep.
G.cue: Land quiet – like a cat.
G.avoid: Stiff-legged landings that jar the knees.

G.name: Deep Squat Hold
steps: Feet a little wider than shoulders, toes out.
Sink as low as you can, elbows pressing knees outward.
Keep heels down – hold onto a post if you need balance.
Breathe slowly and relax into the position.
G.cue: Long exhales let the hips open further.

G.name: Wall Sit
steps: Back flat against a wall, slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Knees stacked over ankles, feet hip-width.
Arms crossed or by your sides – don't push on your legs.
Hold, breathing steadily.
G.cue: Press your low back into the wall.

G.name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding weights in front of your thighs, soft knees.
Push your hips back like closing a car door with your butt.
Slide the weights down your legs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze glutes to drive hips forward and stand tall.
G.cue: Weights stay close – shave your legs with them.
G.avoid: Rounding your back or turning it into a squat.

G.name: Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with upper back against a bench, weight across your hips.
Feet flat, about hip-width, knees bent ~90° at the top.
Tuck chin, drive through heels and lift hips until body is a straight line.
Squeeze glutes hard for one second, lower with control.
G.cue: Ribs down, slight posterior pelvic tilt at the top.
G.avoid: Arching the lower back instead of using glutes.

G.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat (or on a wall for wall bridges).
Press your low back gently into the floor.
Drive through heels and lift hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Pause and squeeze, then lower one vertebra at a time.
G.cue: Think 'squeeze a coin between your glutes'.

G.name: Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall and take a long step forward.
Lower until both knees are about 90°, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front heel and bring the back foot forward into the next step.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.
G.cue: Front knee tracks over the middle toes.
G.avoid: Short steps that overload the front knee.

G.name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the edge of a step, heels hanging off.
Rise as high as possible onto the balls of your feet.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly below step level.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.
G.cue: Slow 3-second lowering builds the most strength.

G.name: Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet planted.
Squeeze shoulder blades together and down.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows ~45° from your body.
Press up and slightly back over your shoulders.
G.cue: Keep your shoulder blades pinned the whole set.
G.avoid: Flaring elbows to 90° or bouncing off the chest.

G.name: Push-Up
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows ~45° from your sides.
Touch chest just above the floor.
Push the floor away to return. Drop to knees or use a wall to scale.
G.cue: Squeeze glutes so your hips don't sag.
G.avoid: Hips sagging or head poking forward.

G.name: Overhead Press
steps: Stand with weights at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace core and squeeze glutes.
Press straight up, moving your head back slightly to clear the path.
Finish with biceps by your ears, then lower with control.
G.cue: Ribs down – don't lean back.
G.avoid: Arching the lower back to finish the rep.

G.name: Row
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back (or brace one hand on a bench for dumbbell rows).
Let the weight hang straight down.
Pull the elbow back toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
G.cue: Lead with the elbow, not the hand.
G.avoid: Jerking the weight with your torso.

G.name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Hold a band at shoulder height, arms straight, hands shoulder-width.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze shoulder blades together for a beat.
Return slowly.
G.cue: Keep shoulders down away from ears.

G.name: Bicep Curl
steps: Stand tall, weights at your sides, palms forward.
Pin elbows to your ribs.
Curl weights up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly over 2-3 seconds.
G.cue: Only your forearms should move.

G.name: Tricep Dip
steps: Hands on a bench or chair edge behind you, fingers forward.
Legs bent (easier) or straight (harder).
Bend elbows straight back to ~90°.
Press back up to straight arms.
G.cue: Keep your back close to the bench.
G.avoid: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders.

G.name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Step feet back so your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze glutes and pull belly button toward spine.
Breathe steadily and hold.
G.cue: Imagine pulling your elbows toward your toes.

G.name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side, elbow under shoulder.
Stack feet (or stagger for balance).
Lift hips so your body is a straight line from head to feet.
Hold, then switch sides.
G.cue: Push the floor away with your forearm.

G.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent 90° over hips.
Press your low back flat into the floor.
Slowly extend opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
G.cue: Exhale fully as you extend.
G.avoid: Low back arching off the floor.

G.name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind head, legs lifted.
Bring one knee in while rotating the opposite elbow toward it.
Extend the other leg long.
Alternate in a slow, controlled pedaling motion.
G.cue: Rotate from your ribs, not your neck.

G.name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back ~45°, chest tall.
Hold a weight or clasp hands.
Rotate your torso to tap beside one hip, then the other.
Lift feet for more challenge.
G.cue: Move your shoulders, not just your arms.

G.name: Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat, hands under your hips for support.
Keep legs straight and together.
Raise legs to vertical.
Lower slowly, stopping before your back arches.
G.cue: Low back stays glued to the floor.

G.name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat and place hands on the floor.
Jump or step feet back into a plank.
Chest to floor (optional), then jump feet back to hands.
Explode up with a small jump and clap overhead.
G.cue: Find a rhythm you can keep – smooth beats fast.

G.name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs like running in place.
Keep hips level with shoulders.
G.cue: Shoulders stay over wrists.

G.name: High Knees
steps: Stand tall, run in place.
Drive knees up to hip height.
Pump arms in rhythm.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
G.cue: Quick feet, tall posture.

G.name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Feet wider than hips, kettlebell a foot in front of you.
Hinge and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back, hinge again and repeat.
G.cue: It's a hip snap, not an arm lift.
G.avoid: Squatting the swing or lifting with your arms.

G.name: Wall Ball
steps: Hold a medicine ball at chest, stand an arm's length from a wall.
Squat to parallel.
Drive up and throw the ball to a target ~10 ft high.
Catch it and flow into the next squat.
G.cue: Use your legs to throw, arms just guide.
G.avoid: Catching it standing tall and then squatting.

G.name: Farmer Carry
steps: Pick up heavy weights in each hand with a flat back.
Stand tall, shoulders back and down.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Set the weights down with a hip hinge.
G.cue: Walk like you're balancing a book on your head.

G.name: Sled Push
steps: Grip the sled handles with arms extended or bent.
Lean in at ~45°.
Drive with short powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
No sled? Push a loaded plate on turf or do a heavy plank-walk.
G.cue: Keep hips low and back flat.

G.name: Burpee Broad Jump
steps: Do a burpee: chest to floor.
Jump feet in.
Swing arms and jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly and repeat.
G.cue: Land in a quarter squat to absorb force.

G.name: Cat-Cow
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Inhale: drop belly, lift chest and tailbone (cow).
Exhale: round your back, tuck chin and tailbone (cat).
Move slowly with your breath.
G.cue: Move one vertebra at a time.

G.name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step into a deep lunge, both hands inside the front foot.
Drop the inside elbow toward the ankle.
Rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling.
Return, straighten front leg for a hamstring stretch, switch sides.
G.cue: Follow your top hand with your eyes.

G.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
steps: Sit with both knees bent 90°, one in front, one to the side.
Sit tall, hands behind you if needed.
Rotate both knees to the other side without using your hands.
Keep alternating slowly.
G.cue: Lead with the knees, keep the chest tall.

G.name: Thoracic Rotation
steps: Lie on your side, knees bent 90° and stacked, arms straight in front.
Open the top arm across your body like a book.
Follow your hand with your eyes until it rests on the other side.
Return slowly.
G.cue: Keep knees together and down.

G.name: Leg Circles
steps: Lie on your back, one leg extended to the ceiling.
Draw small controlled circles with the lifted leg.
Keep the pelvis still.
Reverse direction, then switch legs.
G.cue: Small and controlled beats big and wobbly.

G.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
steps: Set incline (e.g. 12%) and speed (e.g. 3.0 mph).
Walk tall without holding the rails.
Short, quick steps; push through your whole foot.
Lower the incline if you need the handrails.
G.cue: Hands-free makes it work.

G.name: Easy Run / Jog
steps: Start with a 5-minute brisk walk.
Jog at a pace where you can still talk in short sentences.
Land under your hips with quick light steps.
Relax shoulders and hands.
G.cue: Slower than you think – conversational pace.

G.name: Zone 2 Cardio
steps: Choose a bike, rower, incline walk or easy jog.
Keep heart rate around 60-70% of max (roughly 180 minus your age).
You should be able to talk but not sing.
Hold the effort steady for the full session.
G.cue: Use your watch's heart-rate readout to stay in zone.

G.name: Stair Climber
steps: Step on, set a steady level.
Stand tall, light fingertips on rails only for balance.
Push through your whole foot on each step.
Raise the speed for fast intervals, then ease back.
G.cue: Drive through the heel to work your glutes.
G.avoid: Leaning on the rails with straight arms.

G.name: Interval Walking
steps: Walk fast enough that talking is hard (about 70% effort) for 3 minutes.
Slow to an easy stroll for 3 minutes.
Swing your arms and keep your posture tall.
Repeat 5 rounds.
G.cue: Fast walks should feel like a 'somewhat hard' effort.
G.avoid: Making every interval the same easy pace.

G.name: Shadowboxing
steps: Stand in a boxing stance: feet staggered, hands guarding your chin.
Jab: snap the lead hand straight out and back.
Cross: rotate your back hip and throw the rear hand.
Hook: bend the elbow 90° and swing from your hips.
G.cue: Exhale sharply on every punch.
G.avoid: Locking your elbows at full extension.

G.name: Rowing Machine
steps: Strap in, grab the handle, shins vertical.
Drive with your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Finish by pulling the handle to your lower ribs.
Return: arms, then body, then bend the knees.
G.cue: Legs, body, arms. Then arms, body, legs.
G.avoid: Pulling with your arms before your legs push.

G.name: Indoor Cycling
steps: Set the seat at hip height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Warm up spinning at light resistance.
Climbs: add resistance and slow your cadence.
Sprints: lighter resistance, fast legs, stay seated.
G.cue: Keep your upper body relaxed and still.
G.avoid: Bouncing in the saddle at high speed.

G.name: Freestyle Swim
steps: Push off on your front, body long and flat.
Alternate arms: reach, pull under your body, push past the hip.
Turn your head to the side to breathe every 2-3 strokes.
Keep a steady flutter kick from the hips.
G.cue: Keep one eye in the water when you breathe.
G.avoid: Lifting your whole head forward to breathe.

G.name: Sun Salutation A
steps: Inhale, reach your arms overhead.
Exhale, fold forward. Inhale, half lift.
Step back to plank, lower down, then upward dog.
Exhale to downward dog for 5 breaths, step forward, rise up.
G.cue: One breath per movement.

G.name: Downward Dog
steps: From hands and knees, tuck toes and lift hips up and back.
Hands shoulder-width, fingers spread.
Press the floor away and lengthen your spine.
Bend the knees as much as you need.
G.cue: A long back matters more than straight legs.
G.avoid: Rounding the back to force the heels down.

G.name: Warrior II
steps: Step feet wide, front toes forward, back foot turned in.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Reach arms out at shoulder height.
Look over your front hand.
G.cue: Sink the hips while lifting through the chest.

G.name: Triangle Pose
steps: Feet wide, front toes forward, both legs straight.
Reach forward over the front leg, then hinge sideways.
Rest your hand on your shin or a block.
Reach the top arm to the sky.
G.cue: Imagine your body between two panes of glass.
G.avoid: Collapsing the chest toward the floor.

G.name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel, big toes together, knees apart.
Sit hips back to your heels.
Walk hands forward and rest your forehead down.
Breathe slowly into your back.
G.cue: Let each exhale soften you further.
G.avoid: Forcing hips down if knees complain. Add a pillow.

G.name: Pilates Hundred
steps: Lie down, legs in tabletop or extended at 45°.
Curl head and shoulders up, arms long by your sides.
Pump arms up and down in small pulses.
Inhale for 5 pulses, exhale for 5. Ten rounds.
G.cue: Keep the low back gently pressed down.
G.avoid: Straining your neck. Rest your head if needed.

G.name: Roll-Up
steps: Lie flat, arms overhead, legs long.
Raise arms, curl chin to chest and peel up one vertebra at a time.
Reach for your toes with a rounded spine.
Roll back down slowly.
G.cue: Move slowly. Control beats momentum.

G.name: Single-Leg Stretch
steps: Curl head and shoulders up, hug one knee in.
Extend the other leg long at 45°.
Switch legs, swapping hands to the bent knee.
Keep your torso still.
G.cue: Exhale each time you switch.
G.avoid: Rocking the torso side to side.

G.name: Pilates Swimming
steps: Lie face down, arms and legs long.
Lift chest, arms and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg in small quick beats.
Keep your neck long, eyes down.
G.cue: Lengthen out before you lift up.
G.avoid: Cranking your neck up to look forward.

G.name: Neck & Shoulder Rolls
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Drop your chin and slowly roll the head ear to ear.
Roll shoulders up, back and down 10 times.
Reverse direction.
G.cue: Slow and easy, never forced.

G.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee, other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Shift forward gently until you feel the front of the hip stretch.
Reach the same-side arm overhead for more.
G.cue: The tuck matters more than how far you lean.

G.name: Lat Pulldown / Pull-Up
steps: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull shoulder blades down first.
Pull elbows toward your ribs until the chin passes the bar (or bar reaches your chest).
Lower with control to full stretch.
G.cue: Think 'elbows to back pockets'.

G.name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at face height on a cable or band.
Pull the rope toward your eyes, elbows high.
Pull the ends apart beside your ears.
Return slowly.
G.cue: Finish in a 'double biceps' pose.

G.name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall, light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise arms out to the sides with soft elbows.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower over 2-3 seconds.
G.cue: Lead with the elbows, pinkies slightly up.

G.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set bench to 30°, dumbbells at shoulder level.
Shoulder blades back and down.
Press up and slightly in.
Lower to a stretch at chest level.
G.cue: Wrists stacked over elbows.
G.avoid: Too steep an incline turning it into a shoulder press.

G.name: Legs Up the Wall
G.mus: Calms the nervous system, eases tired legs
steps: Sit sideways next to a wall.
Swing your legs up the wall as you lie back.
Rest your arms out to the sides, palms up.
Breathe slowly for 3-5 minutes.
G.cue: Scoot your hips as close to the wall as comfortable.
G.avoid: Forcing straight legs if hamstrings are tight. Bend the knees.

G.name: Supine Spinal Twist
steps: Lie on your back and hug one knee in.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor.
Stretch the opposite arm out and look that way.
Hold 60 seconds, then switch.
G.cue: Let gravity do the work. Relax with every exhale.

G.name: Seated Forward Fold
steps: Sit with legs straight in front of you.
Inhale tall, then exhale and fold forward from the hips.
Rest your hands wherever they reach.
Breathe slowly and soften.
G.cue: Bend your knees so your back can relax.

G.name: Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet and sit tall.
Let your knees fall open.
Lean forward slightly for more stretch.
G.cue: Gently flutter the knees to release tension.
G.avoid: Pressing your knees down with your hands.

G.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
steps: Sit or lie comfortably and exhale fully.
Breathe in quietly through your nose for 4 counts.
Hold for 7 counts.
Exhale through your mouth for 8 counts. Repeat 4 times.
G.cue: Slow and gentle. The long exhale is what calms you.
G.avoid: Straining. Shorten the counts if you feel light-headed.
